caption: The drawing depicts a single candlestick rendered in grayscale pencil or ink, with shading to indicate its metallic quality and three-dimensional form. The candlestick has a flared base, a slender, slightly tapering stem with three distinct bulbous sections separated by narrow necks, and a broad, disc-like top to support a candle. The overall shape combines smooth curves with sharp transitions at each section. The main object is centrally placed within a simple rectangular border. Below the main illustration, there are two smaller diagrams: one on the left showing the top view with labeled measurements, and one on the right showing a side elevation with dimensions. The artist's name "MEYERS" appears below the main candlestick. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color, consistent throughout the drawing. The composition is orderly, with a focus on technical details and clear line work around the main candlestick and the measurement diagrams.
title: Candlestick
